research_rationale:
EO 12974 of September 29, 1995 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees), read in full in the held Federal Register text (60 FR 51875, Federal Register of October 3, 1995; machine-extracted text layer). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1995-09-29). Sec. 1 continues fifteen advisory committees until September 30, 1997; Sec. 2 assigns the Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to department heads; Sec. 3 revokes two committee orders or sections; Sec. 4 supersedes EO 12869; Sec. 5 makes the order effective September 30, 1995. Inventory: the dossier's 22 clauses (Sec. 1 with items (a) to (o), Sec. 2, Sec. 3 with items (a) and (b), Sec. 4, 5) cover every operative sentence. The continuance clauses end on 1997-09-30 by EO 13062 Sec. 4, effective under its Sec. 7; Sec. 3 to 5 are performed or spent on the effective date 1995-09-30. The dossier flagged missing located provisions for EO 12887 and EO 12912; they amend EO 12878, which Sec. 3(a) revokes, and do not name this order. Search: besides the dossier's machine searches, I ran a by-number scan of all held order texts for the fifteen committees' establishing-order numbers; among orders signed between 1995-09-30 and 1997-09-29 the scan's hits are EO 12983 (amends EO 12871), EO 12991 (amends EO 12131) and EO 12994 (supersedes EO 11776 and continues the Mental Retardation Committee); none names EO 12974 or ends a continuance. Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning. Machine hits for this order: current-law:usc 0, current-law:ecfr 0, later-events:ofr_catalog 3. The packet's by-number scan of held order texts (LOOKUPS) was read for this order; held texts citing this number are its own text and EO 13062, the superseding order.
